probability-vanishing-spikes.kind: analytic teaching construction; not experimental data
probability-vanishing-spikes.difficulty: Almost sure/probability convergence need not control expectation without uniform integrability.
probability-vanishing-spikes.formula: U~Uniform(0,1); V_n(U)=n*I(U<=1/n); E[V_n]=1; P(V_n>1)=1/n for n>=2.
probability-vanishing-spikes.design_intent: Two aligned panels distinguish sample-path value from averaged quantities; blue solid/red dashed comparisons with explicit legends. No line crosses either jump.
probability-vanishing-spikes.processing: Direct deterministic evaluation; no random sampling, filtering or smoothing.

stochastic-stepsize-bias-variance.kind: analytic teaching construction; not experimental data
stochastic-stepsize-bias-variance.difficulty: A vanishing bias does not imply that fixed-step noise variance vanishes.
stochastic-stepsize-bias-variance.formula: theta_(t+1)=(1-alpha_t)*theta_t+alpha_t*Y_(t+1); fixed mean=1-.8^t; fixed variance=(1-.8^(2t))/9; sample mean has expectation 1 and variance 1/t for t>=1.
stochastic-stepsize-bias-variance.design_intent: Same update-count scale and color/line encoding across two panels; mean and variance are separate quantities, not confidence bands or simulated paths.
stochastic-stepsize-bias-variance.processing: Direct deterministic evaluation; no random sampling, filtering or smoothing.

statistics-local-boundary-fit.kind: analytic teaching construction; not experimental data
statistics-local-boundary-fit.difficulty: Local linear fitting returns the fitted intercept to the boundary instead of averaging one-sided responses.
statistics-local-boundary-fit.formula: Weighted least squares on design [1,x]; constant=sum(w*y)/sum(w)=10.25; linear fit=9.2+1.4*x.

parameters.weights_are: fixed teaching construction, not kernel values inferred from a bandwidth

statistics-local-boundary-fit.design_intent: Neutral observations and colored fitted functions; open squares mark the two boundary predictions. Unknown true conditional mean is deliberately not drawn.
statistics-local-boundary-fit.processing: Direct deterministic evaluation; no random sampling, filtering or smoothing.

information-binary-channel-information.kind: analytic teaching construction; not experimental data
information-binary-channel-information.difficulty: Noise divides a fixed input entropy into revealed information and remaining uncertainty.
information-binary-channel-information.formula: X~Bernoulli(.5); N~Bernoulli(epsilon) independent; Y=X xor N; H(X|Y)=Hb(epsilon); I(X;Y)=log(2)-Hb(epsilon). Natural logarithms; 0*log(0)=0.
information-binary-channel-information.design_intent: One shared axis shows two complementary information quantities; input entropy is a neutral reference. Blue solid and red dashed curves remain distinguishable in grayscale.
information-binary-channel-information.processing: Direct deterministic evaluation; no random sampling, filtering or smoothing.

causal-cross-world-couplings.kind: analytic teaching construction; not experimental data
causal-cross-world-couplings.difficulty: Identical intervention marginals and zero ATE do not determine individual effects or conditional counterfactuals.
causal-cross-world-couplings.formula: Joint matrices for (Y(0),Y(1)): A=[[.5,0],[0,.5]], B=[[0,.5],[.5,0]]. Both marginals Bernoulli(.5); ATE=0. Individual effects are 0 under A, and +1/-1 with probabilities .5/.5 under B.
causal-cross-world-couplings.design_intent: Aligned 2x2 probability heatmaps use a shared white-to-yellow scale and explicit cell values; equal margins are verified numerically. No colorbar is needed for the two directly printed values.
causal-cross-world-couplings.processing: Direct deterministic evaluation; no random sampling, filtering or smoothing.
